hand_semantics.frame: arm2_link7 wrist coordinates; right-handed XYZ; all directions are unit vectors in this wrist frame
hand_semantics.thumb_opposition_description: Increasing dimension 0 swings the thumb from the index side across the palm toward the other fingers; the vector is its tip displacement from minimum to maximum opposition with fingers extended, not a fixed rotation axis.

approximate_opening_width_m.definition: Measured unloaded stable open/close command endpoints under native drives and self-contact; fingertip-pad surface separation estimated from validated USD geometry. Intermediate posture and gravity change the gap. Target limits may be unreachable together due to self-contact; this is not an object clearance guarantee.

static_robot.interface: absolute WORLD wrist pose plus six native hand radians

candidate.visual_observation: The brown bottle is upright on the table, with no hand contact. Camera images and calibration suggest its body centre is approximately [-1.12, -5.11, 0.99] m in world coordinates. The measured right wrist is above and laterally separated from it. This chunk approaches with the hand open; it does not attempt a premature closure or lift.
candidate.memory_for_next_observation: Initial approach only; stable lifting is not established. Estimated bottle body centre from calibrated images: approximately [-1.12, -5.11, 0.99] m, with table near z=0.90 m. Requested two 0.145 m wrist translations downward and toward the bottle. Orientation changes approximately 0.53 rad each, ending with fingers along world +X, palm outward toward +Y, and finger row toward +Z. Hand remains open. Inspect actual wrist tracking and bottle-relative hand position before further approach, thumb opposition, body closure, or lifting.

Measured wrist tracking is close to the previous target. Calibrated fixed-camera views suggest bottle body centre approximately [-1.12,-5.11,0.98] m; its base appears nearer z=0.94 m than the earlier rough estimate. Maintain the current side-grasp orientation and approach without closing yet.
candidate.memory_for_next_observation: Approach only; grasp and stable lift are not established. Current orientation approximately [0.5,-0.5,0.5,-0.5] maps extended fingers to world +X, palm outward to +Y, and little-to-index row to +Z. Requested open-hand approach through [-1.279,-5.215,1.038] to [-1.279,-5.172,0.984], keeping translation steps below 0.15 m. Fixed-camera estimates: bottle centre x about -1.12, y about -5.11; body around z0.98, base around z0.94, cap around z1.08. Final wrist is deliberately offset on negative-Y side; inspect palm clearance, finger longitudinal alignment, and thumb position before opposing/closing. Actual thumb flexion has lagged the open target (~0.544 measured vs 0.64 requested). Do not lift before assessing contact.
